items.title: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学 / Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity

sources.title: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学 / Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.title_zh: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学
sources.title_original: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章展示 Google Antigravity 搭配 Cheminformatics Skills，在真实肺癌治疗案例中让 agent 搜索数千化合物、做 matched molecular pair analysis，并在一小时内提出 novel rigidified macrocycles 及合成路线，而传统单次迭代常需多天。

en.reason: In a real lung cancer case, Google Antigravity with Cheminformatics Skills let an agent search thousands of compounds, run matched molecular pair analysis, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles and synthesis routes within an hour, versus days for typical iteration.

sources.title_zh: GitHub Desktop 新增短时效认证令牌
sources.title_en: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
sources.title_original: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 起，符合条件账户登录可使用短时自动刷新认证令牌，降低泄露令牌可用时长，并自动为 GitHub API 请求和 Git 操作续期；功能正逐步覆盖，暂不含 GitHub Enterprise Server。

en.reason: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 and later now gives eligible accounts short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens, reducing a leaked token's usable window and auto-renewing them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, though the rollout excludes GitHub Enterprise Server.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Tencent Hunyuan 发布 Hyra2.0，让通用 Agent 深度参与科学工具与模型研发；其 Hyra1.0 基于 Hy3 全自动解决悬置五十多年的 sum sets 与 difference sets 最优指数问题。

en.title: Tencent Hunyuan unveils Hyra 2.0, letting AI Agents take full part in scientific foundation models and hardcore R&D
en.reason: Tencent Hunyuan's Hyra 2.0 puts general AI agents into scientific tool and model R&D, after Hyra 1.0, built on Hy3, autonomously solved the 50-year-old optimal exponent problem for sum sets and difference sets.
